senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. Mount Zion, Zion (= Jerusalem).
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 48:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII</cite> <he>אבל בצ׳ אינו כן</he> but this is not the case with the city of Zion.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 87:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXVII</cite> <he>צ׳ שהוא פלטין שלי</he> Zion which is my (the Lord’s) palace; a. fr.
